metadata.scenario: A patient calls to reschedule their cancelled appointment due to a conflicting doctor's visit. The receptionist rebooks for next Wednesday at 2 PM. Polite, straightforward call.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking, how can I assist you today? Hi Margaret, this is Mark Johnson. I need to reschedule an appointment for my parents. Of course, Mark. I’d be happy to help with that. What day was the appointment originally scheduled for? It was for this Friday, but they have a doctor's visit that day. I understand. Let’s get that rescheduled. How about next Wednesday? Yes, that works. What time do you have available? We have an opening at 2 PM next Wednesday. Would that be suitable? Yes, that sounds perfect. Great! I’ll go ahead and book that for you. Thank you. And just to confirm, this is for medication management, right? Yes, that’s correct. Our nurse will assist with medication reminders and supervision. Excellent. My parents have also mentioned needing transportation to their appointments. We do offer transportation services as well, if you’re interested. Yes, I’d like to know more about that. Our transportation services range from $45 to $65 per trip, depending on the distance. That sounds reasonable. Can I arrange that for them as well? Absolutely! We can set that up during their next visit or you can call us anytime to schedule. Perfect. I’ll do that. Just to confirm, their new appointment is set for Wednesday at 2 PM? Yes, I’ve got you booked for next Wednesday at 2 PM for medication management. Thank you, Margaret. I appreciate your help. You’re very welcome, Mark! If you have any more questions or need further assistance, feel free to call. Will do. Have a great day! You too! Thank you for choosing CareFirst Home Health. Goodbye! Goodbye!
